_doc: Tight budget forcing real tradeoffs. Solver should drop low-score expensive options in favor of high-score cheap ones, respecting team_size cap.
_expected_outcome: Greedy picks top-3 by score and runs out of budget after 2. Solver finds the optimal 3-channel mix beneath the cap.
_optimum_note: Calibrated against canonical template on 2026-05-19. Tight budget ($15K) forces solver to satisfy min_compounding + min_fast_feedback under team_size=1 cap. Greedy would over-allocate to high-score LinkedIn ($8K min) and miss compounding floor.
